verdict.rationale: The Pipecat framework follows Semantic Versioning, and its changelog has explicit Deprecated sections that name removal targets (e.g. 'will be removed in 2.0.0'). A dedicated 1.0 migration guide confirms that deprecations are staged before removal at the major version. However, the Cloud REST API is versioned only by its /v1 URL path, with no documented deprecation window, and there is no standalone formal deprecation policy stating timelines. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation window or policy for the Pipecat Cloud REST API, a formal standalone deprecation-policy document with guaranteed timelines, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: this project adheres to Semantic Versioning
Pipecat 1.0 removes many deprecated APIs from the 0.0.x series. If you were already using the non-deprecated replacements, most of these changes won't affect you.
